placement: Core (kernel mechanism). The kernel bound only <body>, so document metadata in <head> — the title, meta description and robots, the canonical link — could not be projected, and a server renderer could produce head content the client could never keep in step. Binding <head> with the same data-text / data-bind-* rules and the same binding policy (an unsafe canonical URL is refused like any other) is the universal mechanism; a pack would be a second, competing path for the same projection. No wire change.

expansions.reason: Binding <head> met the binding policy refusing every <meta> and <link>; the inert page-metadata forms had to be allowed there, and the static view checker calls the same policy with the element attributes it now reads.
